content: Daniel nan Pesen Laion kan
Darius eri kupwurehda en idihada kepina 120 nan sapwellime wehio pwon.
Ih eri pil ketin pilada Daniel oh pil riemen pwe re en tetehk doadoahk en kepina kan oh tehk mehkan me kesempwal pahn nanmwarki.

Eri, Daniel ahpw mwadang kasalehda me e kak doadoahk mwahusang ienge kaun teiko de kepina ko. Eri, pwehki eh doadoahk eh mwahu mehlel, nanmwarkio ahpw kupwurehda en ketikihong manaman en kaunda mehkoaros nan wehio.

Kaunen doadoahk teiko oh kepina ko ahpw song en rapahki en Daniel sapwung ni eh wiewia kaunen wehi. Ahpw re sohte kak diarada sapwung de mehkot suwed reh, pwe Daniel uhdahn ohl likilik men, oh e sohte kin wia mehkot sapwung de mehkot suwed.
Irail eri ndapene nanpwungarail, “Kitail sohte pahn diar mehkot me kitail kak kedipahki Daniel, ihte, mehkot me pidahda kosonned en eh Koht.”
Irail eri pokonlahng tuhwong nanmwarkio oh patohwanohng, “Maing, Nanmwarki Darius, komwi en rosoroson kohkohlahte!

Iet kiht koaros me kin patohwan kohwahkihong komwi sapwellimomwi wehi—kaun akan, kepina kan, oh keriaun kepina kan, oh pil lapalap teikan—pwungkidahr me Wasa Lapalap en ketin wiahda ehu koasoandi oh kamanahla. Kosonned wet en keinepwihsang aramas koaros en peki mehkot sang rehn arail koht de aramas emen sohte lipilipil erein rahn 30, ahpw ihte, sang rehn Wasa Lapalap. Eri, mehmen me pahn kauwehla kosonned wet en lekdekiong nan pesen laion kan.
Eri, Wasa Lapalap, en ketin padokada oh sainih kosonned wet, pwe en kin manaman duwehte kosonned en mehn Media oh Persia kan, me sohte kak wekidekla.”
Nanmwarki Darius eri ketin padokada oh sainih kosonnedo.

Ni Daniel eh rongada me Darius ketin sainiher kosonnedo, e ahpw kohkohla ni imweo. E ahpw kohdahla powe nan pere ehu me wenihmwtok kei mie me sallahng Serusalem. Ih eri kelehpwikihdi wasao duwen eh kin epwehnki wia, oh kapakapohng Koht pak siluh rahn ehu. Eri, wenihmwtok ko langalangete.
Ni ahnsou me en Daniel imwintihti ko kilangada duwen Daniel eh kin wia kapakapohng eh Koht.

Irail koaros eri wiahkinteieu patolahng rehn nanmwarkio pwe re en kedipa Daniel, patohwan, “Maing, Wasa Lapalap, komw ketin sainiher kosonned ehu me mahsanih ma mehmen pahn peki mehkot erein rahn 30 rehn eh koht de rehn aramas emen sohte lipilipil, ahpw kaidehn rehn Wasa Lapalap, e pahn lekdekiong nan pesen laion.” Nanmwarkio eri ketin sapeng, mahsanih, “Ei, kosonned kehlail ehu met, duwehte kosonned en mehn Media oh Persia, me sohte kak wekidekla.”

Irail eri patohwanohng nanmwarkio, “Daniel, emen me kalipilipdo sang Suda ko, sohte kin wauneki Wasa Lapalap de sohte kin peikiong sapwellimomwi kosonned. Pwe e kin epwehnki wia eh kapakap pak siluh rahn koaros.”
Ni nanmwarkio eh karongehda met, e inenen kupwur toutoukihla; e ahpw ketin song en rapahkihda duwen eh pahn kak kapitala Daniel. E ketin kupwukupwure duwen eh pahn kapitala erein rahn ehu pwon.

Aramas ako eri pwurodohng reh oh patohwanohng, “Maing, Wasa Lapalap, komw ketin mwahngih duwen kosonned en mehn Media oh Persia kan, ma koasoandi ehu me nanmwarki padokada oh sainih, e sohte kak wekidekla.”
Nanmwarkio eri ketin koasoanehdi pwe Daniel en pakahrdo oh lekdekiong nan pesen laion kan. E ahpw mahsanihong Daniel, “Daniel, omw Koht me komwi kin loalopwoatohng en ketin doareikomwihla.”

Irail eri katapwurehiong takai ehu oh perehkihla ewen pwoaren laiono. Pein nanmwarkio eri sidampiekihdi sapwellime ringo oh en me lapalap ako sidamp pohn takaio pwe aramas de kohdo oh kapitala Daniel.
Nanmwarkio eri ketin sapahlla ni tehnpeseo oh sohte konote mehkot nipwongo, de pil sohte ketin iang sapwellime ko ni kemweit en tehnpaso. E pil sohte seimwok nipwongo.
Nin sohrahnie nanmwarkio ahpw opala wasa, oh mwadangete ketilahng ni pesen laiono.
Ni eh kerenlahng ni pesen laiono, e ahpw kapitie laudida, mahsanih, “Daniel, ladun Koht ieias! Ia duwe, omwi Koht me komwi kin loalopwoatohng, e ketin doareikomwihla sang laion kan de soh?”
Daniel eri patohwan, “Wasa Lapalap en rosorosonte kohkohlahte!

Koht ketin poaronehdo sapwellime tohnleng me kakuhpene ewen laion kat pwe re dehr kauweiehla. Koht ketin wiahda met pwehki eh ketin mwahngih duwen ei mwakelekel, oh duwen ei sohte wiahda mehkot sapwung ong komwi, Wasa Lapalap.”
Nanmwarkio eri kupwurperenkihda kowahlap met, e ahpw mahsanih Daniel en kapedoisang nan pwoaren laiono. Irail eri, kapedoi, oh sohte diarada kisin ohla kis reh, pwehki eh pwoson Koht.

Nanmwarkio eri ketin koasoanehdi pwe aramas koaros me kedipahda Daniel en uhd lekdekiong nan poaren laiono, iangahki ar pwoud kan oh nair seri kan. Eri, mwohn ar pwupw nan kepin pwoahro, laion ko lusukirailte oh dapengirailpeseng.
Nanmwarki Darius eri ketin wiahda kisinlikou ehu oh kadarohng tohn wehi koaros, keinek koaros, ong irail kan me kin lokaiahki soangen lokaia teikan koaros en sampah; iet audepe: “Kaselehie, maing ko!
I koasoanedier nan wehiet pwe aramas koaros en wauneki oh lammwiki en Daniel eh Koht.

content.text: oh sapwellime manaman pahn kin duweduwehte kohkohlahte.
e kin ketin wiahda kilel kapwuriamwei oh manaman akan
Ih me ketin kapitala Daniel sang ni manaman en laion kan.”

content: Daniel eri paiamwahula nindokon Darius eh wia nanmwarki, oh pil nindokon Sairus,
mehn Persia, e wia nanmwarki.

footnotes.text: 6.28 SAIRUS: Sairus pil wiahla nanmwarki nan Papilon sang pahr 538 lel pahr 529 mwohn Krais.
